```yaml
name: Sync AI Connector Docs

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 */6 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  sync-docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout airbyte repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          path: airbyte

      - name: Checkout airbyte-ai-connectors repo
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          repository: airbytehq/airbyte-ai-connectors
          path: airbyte-ai-connectors

      - name: Set up Octavia bot GitHub App
        id: octavia-bot
        uses: DataDog/dd-octo-sts-action@acaa02eee7e3bb0839e4272dacb37b8f3b58ba80
        with:
          domain: github.com
          audience: api.github.com
          scope: "repo"
          policy: "https://api.github.com/app/installations"

      - name: Run sync script
        run: |
          DEST_DIR="docs/ai-agents/connectors/"
          rm -rf "$DEST_DIR"
          mkdir -p "$DEST_DIR"
          for DIR in $(find airbyte-ai-connectors -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d); do
            CONNECTOR_NAME=$(basename "$DIR")
            echo "Syncing $CONNECTOR_NAME..."
            cp -r "$DIR"/*.md "$DEST_DIR"/
          done

      - name: Create PR
        id: create_pr
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          commit-message: "chore: Sync AI connector docs"
          branch: sync-ai-connector-docs
          title: "Sync AI connector docs"
          body: "Automatically synced AI connector documentation from airbyte-ai-connectors."
          labels: "documentation,auto-merge"
          reviewers: ian-at-airbyte
```
